known_gaps: No per-object size or hash was ever recorded. Only the bucket-wide listed size is known.
Content types are inferred from the file extension, exactly as the legacy edge Worker did at serve time; nothing recorded the stored Content-Type.
The legacy CMS seed also referenced sized WordPress derivatives as display fallbacks. None of those keys exist in R2, so only the full-size object can be imported.
The R2 listing held 2 objects outside the expected set (wv.png on each host); they are recorded in r2_evidence.unexpected_keys and are not part of this manifest.
Site chrome (theme logo, plugin language flags) was referenced by every legacy page but never mirrored; it is listed under unmirrored_references, not as an importable object.
